dedupe_keys.name: nlr pypsse python wrapper for pss e time series power flow dynamic simulation and helics co simulation

description: PyPSSE is a National Laboratory of the Rockies (formerly NREL) Python wrapper around psspy, the Python API of the Power System Simulator for Engineering (PSS/E), for time-series power flow and dynamic simulation of power systems. Contents: it wraps hundreds of psspy calls into a few methods, adds time-series steady-state simulation that PSS/E does not support natively, fully supports dynamic simulation, and has a built-in HELICS interface for steady-state and dynamic co-simulation without extra code. It offers a command line interface to create projects, run simulations and view reports, a RESTful API, and profile and result managers that work with PSS/E channels and psspy calls. Producer: NLR Grid Modernization (contact Aadil Latif). Coverage: any PSS/E model. Format and access: open source code on GitHub linked from the NLR page. Licence (read on 2026-09-29): BSD-3-Clause; requires a PSS/E licence. Caveats: useful only with a PSS/E installation; the page was last updated in March 2025. Simulation uses: transmission-distribution co-simulation, quasi-static time-series studies and dynamic stability runs coupled to other models. Related records: platform-helics, platform-opendss and data-rts-gmlc.
